title: Descent of an integral scalar tensor representative isomorphism
statement: Any natural isomorphism from the ordinary scalar extension of the tensor functor on good representatives to the target tensor functor on their scalar extensions descends to a unique derived natural isomorphism satisfying the square with that specified representative isomorphism. This proved conditional descent is separate from choosing the representative comparison and rewriting its chain formula.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; categories.tex, Tag 04VK (fully faithful localization descent).

proof.text: The two normalized completed-tensor representative comparisons and the exact scalar comparison give r, r′ and the paired coefficient comparison. The product of the two good localizations is a localization; fully faithful whiskering lifts the arbitrary given representative natural isomorphism via functorSquareRepresentativeDescent. Expand the product comparison and the good lifts in its defining equation to obtain the stated normalized square. The same expansion translates its uniqueness clause. Every step is proved, without a new theorem hole. The source and target use the same integralTensorRepresentativeReassociate construction at E and L, with its proved component equation. The paired coefficient isomorphism is a private definition with its own proved component equation. These equations translate the generic normalized square without unfolding their constructions in the main proof.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarTensorRepresentativeDescent
    (eδ : t ⋙ S ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅ (Functor.prod k k) ⋙ s ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) :
    ∃! α : integralCompletedTensor l E W ⋙ integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι W ≅
      (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι W).prod
        (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι W) ⋙ integralCompletedTensor l L W,
      ∀ P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory,
        (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι W).map
            ((integralCompletedTensorComparison l E W).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
          (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).obj (P.obj, Q.obj)) ≫
          eδ.hom.app (P, Q) =
        α.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
          (integralCompletedTensor l L W).map
            (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
              ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P.obj)
              ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q.obj)) ≫
          (integralCompletedTensorComparison l L W).hom.app
            (⟨_, scalarGood l E L ι W P⟩, ⟨_, scalarGood l E L ι W Q⟩)
lean.note: All notation above the theorem is local and expands to the original recorded functors. This is a proved extraction with an arbitrary representative isomorphism as an input, not a new hole.
